NFC Tag-based Information Delivery Solution Start-up All Link will showcase the iPhone touch payment function at CES2022. There will also be an experience space where visitors can use the iPhone touch payment at the local exhibition hall.

Alllink has developed an NFC tag-based information delivery solution that allows users to use services such as payment/reservation/traffic/in and out with only one touch without replacing existing systems.In particular, the payment service has already been commercialized in Seven-Eleven in the Korean market, and has implemented a user experience differentiated from existing QR or barcode payment.
Users' reactions are also receiving many favorable comments such as "The fastest of the pay I have ever seen", "The iPhone is also touch payment!", "It is faster than the existing bar code or QR.

“We plan to accelerate the expansion of the global market by introducing the all-link solution successfully verified by domestic users at CES 2022,” said Kim Kyung-dong, CEO of All-link. “We are confident that improving security and convenience will make us competitive in the important payment solution market.”

Meanwhile, 'CES', the world's largest IT exhibition, is an exhibition where you can grasp the trends of the global home appliance industry at a glance. Hosted by the Consumer Technology Association (CTA), it is held every January. AVING NEWS, which has been covering CES for 16 consecutive years, has been sending the most news to the world every year since 2006, and 'BEST OF CES 2022', which selects the best innovative products and technologies, is selected as a notable company among Korean companies. 'BEST OF MADE IN KOREA' will be held. In addition, AVING LIVE, which conveys issues from the CES site, will be held for 7 days including Media Day.
